name: KV30 Smart Premium Experience Contract
principles: Internal-first smart experience; external AI is never required for core creation.
One account may act as reader/listener/viewer and author/creator without separate accounts.
23-language contract applies to UI, content, creator tools and AI requests.
Creator-facing AI proposes and assists; it does not silently publish or mutate approved work.
Reader AI assists on request and does not interrupt ordinary reading with unsolicited correction.
Emotion and intent are preserved as structured creation metadata wherever the runtime supports it.
Premium visual presentation must remain functional, responsive, accessible and localized.
